svg.title: Uatu contribution workflow
svg.desc: Six delivery steps: approve intent, implement and evolve, validate and review locally, gather GitHub evidence, accept tradeoffs, sync and archive then merge. Hosted automation and native client verification remain pending.
svg.text: From agreed intent to an evidence-backed PR
CONTRIBUTING.md owns the workflow. Review findings are advisory.
1 Agree intent and record the approved Git revision
Approve OpenSpec before behavior or workflow implementation.
Preserve that commit until acceptance. Mechanical edits skip planning.
2 Implement and evolve within the original outcome
Use OpenSpec CLI directly; keep code, tests, docs, and artifacts aligned.
Pause for agreed advance-approval exceptions; safety rules still apply.
3 Validate and review locally before marking ready
Focused checks + independent Standards and Spec contexts.
Use revised requirements; explicitly report when no spec applies.
4 Gather GitHub evidence on the current revision
Applicable CI + fresh independent Standards and Spec review.
External review: maintainer-authorized, read-only; report hosted gaps.
5 Request explicit human acceptance of material tradeoffs
Explain departures from the approved revision, reasons, and consequences.
Show successful checks, evidence, unresolved findings, and limitations.
6 Sync specs, archive, renew affected checks, squash-merge
Retain final artifacts and the short PR explanation, not duplicate snapshots.
Preserve Conventional Commit and release-note override conventions.
At either review: fix valid findings or explain rejection; renew affected checks/review.
Integration limits: native discovery and hosted behavior need recorded verification.
Direct CLI is the autonomous default; generated apply/update remain interactive.
Occasional skill updates are separate: SKILL-MAINTENANCE.svg.
